entities.name: Stromkirk
entities.description: A bloodline of Innistrad vampires who concentrate their power in Nephalia rather than join Stensian politics.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: Progenitor of the Stromkirk vampire line, a high priest in life who worshiped a god of the sea and storms.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Innistrad province where the Stromkirk vampires centre their power, known for its woodcraft.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Innistrad province of the Stensian vampires and their politics.

entities.name: Drunau
entities.description: Nephalian place where the Stromkirk have their ancestral manor and centre of commerce.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane on which the Stromkirk vampires live.

entities.name: Eldrazi spawn
entities.description: Eldrazi offspring into which Stromkirk coastal cultists were transformed.

events.summary: Stromkirk vampires choose to concentrate their power in Nephalia instead of joining Stensian vampire politics.
events.quote: Unwilling to take part in the political and social machinations of Stensian vampires, those of the Stromkirk line chose to concentrate their power in Nephalia instead.

events.summary: Runo Stromkirk uses glamors and his fortune to turn the human populace of Nephalia into artisans, becoming a secret patron.
events.quote: Runo became a kind of secret Nephalian patron, supporting master craftsmen and commissioning buildings, towers, and ships

events.summary: The Stromkirk establish their ancestral manor and commerce centre at Drunau, keeping humans with delicious blood as pampered livestock.
events.quote: Drunau is where the Stromkirk vampires have established their ancestral manor and their center of commerce outside of Stensia.

events.summary: Stromkirk vampires who joined the Nephalian coastal cults are among the first on Innistrad to be transformed into Eldrazi spawn.
events.quote: were among the first of Innistrad's denizens to be transformed into Eldrazi spawn

relations.quote: Some Stromkirk elders have achieved the ability to transform themselves into mist.
